```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

read_with_M <- function(path, ..., pattern = "M(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)", col = "M") {
  fname <- basename(path)
  m <- regexec(pattern, fname, perl = TRUE)
  mt <- regmatches(fname, m)
  if (length(mt[[1]]) < 2) stop("Could not find 'M<digits>' in filename: ", fname)
  M_val <- as.numeric(mt[[1]][2])
  
  df <- utils::read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, ...)
  df[[col]] <- M_val
  df
}

l_psi_M1500 <- read_with_M("l_psi_M1500.csv")
l_psi_M2000 <- read_with_M("l_psi_M2000.csv")
l_psi_M3000 <- read_with_M("l_psi_M3000.csv")

res_null_M1500 <- read_with_M("res_null_M1500.csv")
res_sum_M1500 <- read_with_M("res_sum_M1500.csv")
res_mixture_M1500 <- read_with_M("res_mixture_M1500.csv") %>% arrange(NLL)
res_mixture_M1500 <- res_mixture_M1500[1,]

res_null_M2000 <- read_with_M("res_null_M2000.csv")
res_sum_M2000 <- read_with_M("res_sum_M2000.csv")
res_mixture_M2000 <- read_with_M("res_mixture_M2000.csv") %>% arrange(NLL)
res_mixture_M2000 <- res_mixture_M2000[1,]

res_null_M3000 <- read_with_M("res_null_M3000.csv")
res_sum_M3000 <- read_with_M("res_sum_M3000.csv")
res_mixture_M3000 <- read_with_M("res_mixture_M3000.csv") %>% arrange(NLL)
res_mixture_M3000 <- res_mixture_M3000[1,]

# mean1 and mean2 only useful for mixture model
res_df <- rbind(res_null_M1500, res_sum_M1500, res_mixture_M1500,
                res_null_M2000, res_sum_M2000, res_mixture_M2000,
                res_null_M3000, res_sum_M3000, res_mixture_M3000)
res_df$mean1 <- 1/res_df$phi1
res_df$mean2 <- 1/res_df$phi2

# convert to long
long_est <- res_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(NLL, AIC, BIC, mean, w1, phi1, phi2, mean1, mean2),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "est")

# ######### bootstrap #########  
# List all files starting with "bootstrap" and ending with a seed number
file_list <- list.files(path = "bootstrap", pattern = "^bootstrap.*seed[0-9]+.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Load CSVs, remove the first column, and attach seed number
res_list <- lapply(file_list, function(file) {
  # Read CSV and drop first column
  df <- read.csv(file, check.names = FALSE)
  # if (ncol(df) >= 2) df <- df[, -1, drop = FALSE]

  bn <- basename(file)

  # Extract seed
  seed <- sub(".*seed([0-9]+).*\\.csv$", "\\1", bn)

  # Extract M (supports integers or decimals)
  M_val <- sub(".*_M([0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?)\\.csv$", "\\1", bn)

  # Attach columns
  df$seed <- as.integer(seed)
  df$M    <- as.numeric(M_val)

  # Your derived columns
  df$mean1 <- 1/df$phi1
  df$mean2 <- 1/df$phi2

  df
})

# in each iteration of the bootstrap and for each model, get the estimates with the smallest NLL (only relevant for mixture)
res_boot <- do.call(rbind, res_list) %>%
  group_by(M, model, bootstrap, seed) %>%
  slice_min(NLL, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(model, seed, bootstrap)

# assign different index for each seed and bootstrap
res_boot <- res_boot %>%
  group_by(seed, bootstrap) %>%
  mutate(index = cur_group_id()) %>%   # one id per (seed, bootstrap)
  ungroup()

# there should be 42*12*3*3 rows (seems ok)

# check results for each model
res_boot_null <- res_boot %>% filter(model == "null")
res_boot_sum <- res_boot %>% filter(model == "sum")
res_boot_mixture <- res_boot %>% filter(model == "mixture")

# limit bootstrap index to 500
res_boot <- res_boot %>% filter(index <= 500)
 
# Define desired quantiles
q_probs <- c(0.025, 0.975)
vars <- c("NLL", "AIC", "BIC", "w1", "phi1", "phi2", "mean1", "mean2", "mean")
q_labels <- paste0("q", q_probs * 100)

# Compute quantiles grouped by model, wide format for quantiles
quantiles_by_model <- res_boot %>%
  group_by(M, model) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  map_dfr(function(subdf) {
    M_val     <- unique(subdf$M)
    model_val <- unique(subdf$model)
    
    map_dfr(vars, function(v) {
      q_vals <- quantile(subdf[[v]], probs = q_probs, na.rm = TRUE)
      
      tibble(
        M = M_val,
        model = model_val,
        variable = v,
        q2.5 = q_vals[[1]],
        q97.5 = q_vals[[2]]
      )
    })
  }) %>% arrange(model, M, variable)

res_df <- inner_join(long_est, quantiles_by_model) %>% select(M, model, variable, est, q2.5, q97.5)

res_BIC <- res_df %>% filter(variable == "BIC", M == "1500")

res_df_1500 <- res_df %>% filter(M == "1500")

res_BIC$est[[3]] - res_BIC$est[[1]]
```

```{r}
### Response to reviewers

library(tidyverse)
source("fns_sim.R")

L <- l_psi_M1500$l
psi_i <- l_psi_M1500$psi
# params <- list(w1=res_mixture_M1500$w1,
#                phi1=res_mixture_M1500$phi1,
#                phi2=res_mixture_M1500$phi2,
#                M=1500)
# ---- Inputs ----------------------------------------------------------
M      <- 1500                  

# ---- Helper: average PMF over psi_i ---------------------------------
avg_pmf <- function(l_vals, psi_i, FUN, ...) {
  vapply(l_vals, function(ell) mean(FUN(ell, psi_i, ...)), numeric(1))
}

l_vals <- 2:M

# Geometric model
pmf_geom   <- avg_pmf(l_vals, psi_i, pL_geom_2M, phi = res_null_M1500$phi1, M = M)    

# Sum-of-two-geoms model
pmf_2geom  <- avg_pmf(l_vals, psi_i, pL_geom2_2M, phi = res_sum_M1500$phi1, M = M) 

# Mixture model
pmf_mix    <- avg_pmf(l_vals, psi_i, pL_geom_2M_mixture,
                      w1 = res_mixture_M1500$w1, phi1 = res_mixture_M1500$phi1, phi2 = res_mixture_M1500$phi2, M = M)

# Empirical PMF
emp_cnt <- tabulate(factor(L, levels = l_vals), nbins = length(l_vals))
emp_p   <- emp_cnt / sum(emp_cnt)

### Model fit plot
# ---- Tidy + plot -----------------------------------------------------
df <- tibble(l = l_vals,
             Empirical = emp_p,
             Geometric = pmf_geom,
             Sum   = pmf_2geom,
             Mixture   = pmf_mix) %>%
  pivot_longer(-l, names_to = "series", values_to = "p")

ggplot(df, aes(l)) +
  geom_col(data = dplyr::filter(df, series == "Empirical"),
           aes(y = p), fill = "grey80", width = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = dplyr::filter(df, series != "Empirical"),
            aes(y = p, colour = series), linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Observed tract length (bp)", y = "Log 10 probability") +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10") +
  scale_color_discrete(
    name   = "Model",
    breaks = c("Geometric", "Sum", "Mixture"),   # <- match your actual `series` values
    labels = c("Geometric", "Sum", "Mixture")
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("model_fits.png")
```

```{r}
### Response to reviewers

### Overlap between components
phi1 <- res_df$est[res_df$variable == "phi1" & res_df$model == "mixture"]
phi2 <- res_df$est[res_df$variable == "phi2" & res_df$model == "mixture"]

# mean1 <- 1/phi1
# mean2 <- 1/phi2

# 95% central interval
lower1 <- qgeom(0.025, prob = phi1) + 1
upper1 <- qgeom(0.975, prob = phi1) + 1

lower2 <- qgeom(0.025, prob = phi2) + 1
upper2 <- qgeom(0.975, prob = phi2) + 1

# P(X < L)
lower_tail1 <- 1 - (1-phi1)^(lower1 - 1)
# P(X > U)
upper_tail1 <- (1-phi1)^upper1
# P(L <= X <= U)
1 - lower_tail1 - upper_tail1

lower_tail2 <- 1 - (1-phi2)^(lower2 - 1)
upper_tail2 <- (1-phi2)^upper2
1 - lower_tail2 - upper_tail2

c(lower1, upper1)
c(lower2, upper2)

# degree of overlap with 1.5 kb
(1-phi1)^1500
(1-phi2)^1500
```
